experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
experiences.description: I work on MyTax, a product that started around helping freelancers manage and pay their taxes and has since grown into a broader financial experience, including cash flow features and a new mobile app. I was one of the main engineers behind the mobile application, working across architecture, backend services, cloud infrastructure, and Flutter while helping shape technical decisions as the product evolved. More recently, that work also brought me much closer to AI engineering, building features around LLMs, vector search, agents, and the tooling needed to make them useful inside a real product. I've recently moved to a new team focused on internal AI tooling, where we're building systems that use different models and agents to help plan, execute, and review engineering tasks while keeping quality and cost in mind. Across both teams, my role goes well beyond implementation: I spend a lot of time on architecture, code reviews, production issues, technical trade-offs, and helping the team turn ambiguous problems into maintainable solutions.
experiences.companyInfo: ADP builds products and services around payroll, HR, tax, benefits, and workforce management, serving businesses and workers around the world. I work within ADP's product and engineering organization on newer digital products and platforms.

experiences.title: Development Consultant
experiences.description: At SAP, I worked on SAP Ariba Category Management, building enterprise software with a strong focus on backend architecture and integrations. A big part of the job was understanding complex business requirements and turning them into systems that were easier to evolve and maintain. I worked mostly with Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and SAP's cloud stack, and also spent time integrating AI-powered capabilities into the product. It was also where I became much more involved in architecture discussions, technical decisions, code reviews, and helping other developers work through complex problems.
experiences.companyInfo: SAP develops enterprise software used by companies around the world to manage areas such as finance, procurement, supply chain, HR, and operations. I worked within the SAP Ariba organization, focused on procurement and category management products.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer
experiences.description: I joined Bazk early in my career and grew from a trainee into a full-stack engineering role, which made this one of the places where I learned the most. I worked on payment systems processing more than 400 transactions per minute, so reliability, observability, security, and correctness were part of the job from the beginning. Over time, I became involved in everything from backend services and payment flows to compliance rules, internal tools, automated testing, cloud infrastructure, and production monitoring. It was also my first real exposure to distributed systems and to the kind of engineering decisions that only become obvious once software is handling real money and real traffic.
experiences.companyInfo: Bazk was a fintech focused on payment infrastructure for e-commerce, handling payment processing, checkout flows, financial integrations, and compliance-related systems.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer
experiences.description: This was my first professional experience with software development. I joined as a trainee and worked on Universos, a news aggregation product that collected content from different sources using web scraping. I got to work across the whole stack, building Node.js services, APIs, MongoDB integrations, and React interfaces. More than any specific technology, this was where I learned what it actually meant to work on a software product with other people, ship code, fix things that broke, and turn ideas into something users could interact with.
experiences.companyInfo: Pling Brasil was a small software development startup building digital products and providing development services for clients.
